name: YouTube embed (cross-origin frame)
setup: (() => { const f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.src = 'https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/aqz-KE-bpKQ'; f.width = 640; f.height = 360; f.allow = 'autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture'; document.body.append(f); return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r(1), 6000)); })()

name: YouTube embed, played (cross-origin frame)

name: lab: video added late by script
setup: (() => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => { const v = document.createElement('video'); v.src = '/gen/1M/clip.mp4'; v.controls = true; v.width = 640; v.height = 360; document.body.append(v); r(1); }, 2000)))()

name: lab: click-to-play overlay over the video
setup: (() => { const v = document.querySelector('#video'); v.controls = false; const w = document.createElement('div'); w.style.cssText = 'position:relative;width:640px;height:360px'; v.before(w); w.append(v); const o = document.createElement('div'); o.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:5;background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);cursor:pointer'; w.append(o); return 1; })()

name: lab: closed shadow root player
setup: (() => { const v = document.querySelector('#video'); const h = document.createElement('closed-player'); h.style.display = 'block'; v.before(h); h.attachShadow({ mode: 'closed' }).append(v); return 1; })()

name: lab: player in a modal dialog
setup: (() => { const v = document.querySelector('#video'); const d = document.createElement('dialog'); d.style.cssText = 'padding:0;border:0'; document.body.append(d); d.append(v); d.showModal(); return 1; })()

name: lab: player in a popover
setup: (() => { const v = document.querySelector('#video'); const d = document.createElement('div'); d.popover = 'manual'; d.style.cssText = 'padding:0;border:0'; document.body.append(d); d.append(v); d.showPopover(); return 1; })()

name: lab: player element in full screen
setup: (() => { const v = document.querySelector('#video'); const p = document.createElement('div'); p.style.cssText = 'width:640px;height:360px;background:#000'; v.before(p); p.append(v); v.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:100%'; return p.requestFullscreen().then(() => 1, (e) => 'refused ' + e); })()

name: lab: video element itself in full screen
lab: picture-in-picture
setup: (() => { const v = document.querySelector('#video'); v.muted = true; return v.play().then(() => v.requestPictureInPicture ? v.requestPictureInPicture().then(() => 1, (e) => 'refused ' + e) : 'no PiP API'); })()

name: lab: video in a srcdoc frame
setup: (() => { const f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.width = 680; f.height = 400; f.srcdoc = '<video src="' + location.origin + '/gen/1M/clip.mp4" controls width=640 height=360></video>'; document.body.append(f); return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r(1), 2500)); })()

name: lab: video in a frame written by script
setup: (() => { const f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.width = 680; f.height = 400; document.body.append(f); const d = f.contentDocument; d.open(); d.write('<video src="' + location.origin + '/gen/1M/clip.mp4" controls width=640 height=360></video>'); d.close(); return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r(1), 2500)); })()
